title: Ben's School Day
text:
Ben goes to school every day. His favourite subject is maths. He likes to solve problems with numbers. On Mondays, he also has science class.

In science, Ben looks at plants and animals. The teacher shows the class pictures and videos. Ben likes English too, but he thinks it is harder. His friend Ola likes art the most.

questions.text: What does the teacher show the class in science?
What can we guess about Ben?
Which subject does Ben probably find easier?

vocabulary.definition: a topic that you study at school
questions that you need to think about and solve
the study of plants, animals and nature

paragraph_translations: Ben codziennie chodzi do szkoły. Jego ulubiony przedmiot to matematyka. Lubi rozwiązywać zadania z liczbami. W poniedziałki ma też lekcję przyrody.
Na przyrodzie Ben patrzy na rośliny i zwierzęta. Nauczyciel pokazuje klasie obrazki i filmy. Ben lubi też angielski, ale uważa, że jest trudniejszy. Jego koleżanka Ola najbardziej lubi plastykę.
